entities.summary: Balwyn High School is a state-run high school in the Melbourne suburb of North Balwyn, in Victoria, Australia. It was established in 1954. As of December 2024, it had 2184 students, making it among the largest secondary schools in Victoria. The school is consistently ranked among the highest achieving non-selective government schools. Since 2009, the school has been led by Principal Deborah Harman.
